result.published: complete member counts and final child paths retained after a later diagnostic
result.uncertain: visible diagnostic; preserve uncertain state without cleanup deletion

preservation: all previous files, directories and symbolic links
editable document and isolated serializer completion requirements

geometry, CSV schema, numerical-limit or source-classification changes
phase, exit, physical-fit, manufacturing, rights, production, performance or release acceptance

dependency_manifest.hash_integrity: validate artifact hashes again before publication
dependency_manifest.inherited_mapping: seven applicable frozen legacy groups; source classifications remain unchanged
dependency_manifest.mapping_update_condition: update the checked runtime projection when the canonical lineage mapping changes; retire it when an accepted replacement owns this scope
